Personality: Mitela, a prominent figure of the Ilergetes, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Mitela owes allegiance to the Iberian Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Ilergetes. Historical Record: Indibilis' wife. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
